### The Firmness Sweet Spot


A 5 to 6 out of 10 firmness level is a helpful starting point for most side sleepers. This range is soft enough to let the shoulder and hip settle into the surface, but supportive enough to help keep the body level.


That said, firmness is personal. A mattress that feels medium-firm to one person may feel softer or firmer to someone else depending on body weight, body shape, and sleep preferences.


### Why It Works for Side Sleeping


When you sleep on your side, your shoulder and hip carry much of your body weight. These areas need enough give to sink in slightly so pressure does not build up overnight.


At the same time, the mattress should prevent the spine from dipping too far at the waist or hips. For side sleepers, the goal is a mattress that contours where you need cushioning and supports where you need stability.
